# Hynoe SMP

Hynoe SMP is a long-term modded Minecraft Java survival server focused on progression, community, exploration, village life, economy, bosses, and rare gear.

Canonical site: https://hynoesmp.com/
Server address: hynoesmp.com
Edition: Minecraft Java
Loader/client: Fabric; the Hynoe SMP client pack is required
Join guide: https://hynoesmp.com/join.html
Modpack guide: https://hynoesmp.com/modpack.html
Progression guide: https://hynoesmp.com/progression.html
Village life guide: https://hynoesmp.com/mca.html
Economy guide: https://hynoesmp.com/economy.html
Boss guide: https://hynoesmp.com/bosses.html
Updates: https://hynoesmp.com/updates.html
Watch and play: https://hynoesmp.com/watch.html
Discovery page: https://hynoesmp.com/modded-minecraft-server.html
Discord: https://discord.gg/wYTePCkXd5

## Core systems
- 31-stage Campaign connecting major server systems.
- Genesis Ages gate important tools, armor, dimensions, and power behind play and accomplishments.
- Minecraft Comes Alive village life with relationships, homes, work, marriage, children, guards, and generations.
- Player economy, jobs, trading, and server selling systems.
- Bosses, exploration, structures, rare gear, and long-term progression.
- Waystones and exploration systems help players move through a large persistent world.

## Joining
1. Open the modpack guide and install/import the Hynoe SMP pack with Modrinth.
2. Launch the pack in Minecraft Java.
3. Add `hynoesmp.com` in Multiplayer.
4. Use the Discord for current announcements, rollout status, and support.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-07

## October 7 server review
Minecraft Java 26.2 / Fabric. 178 installed server mod files inspected; ten custom datapacks enabled. Campaign v15.1 and Fall v2.5 are enabled. The Fall event loop time-command repair was uploaded, reloaded, and executed successfully. /ask answered and /next invoked the current-stage function from the console. No mod version upgrades were performed. Missing Mythic Upgrades blocks, Alex’s Mobs effects, and C2ME / Towns and Towers generation issues remain under investigation.

## October 7 integration repairs
Assistant v1.2.2 is loaded. Handbook and Campaign Token links use the live renderer; the Handbook links to the seasonal journal; 28 seasonal callbacks use the existing hf26_menu dispatcher. The original ten custom packs plus an integration override pack are enabled. Frostpale alternatives and a chest-enchantment context issue were repaired. Post-restart startup and console verification had zero ERROR entries; third-party warnings remain. Existing player progress and reward amounts were preserved.

## Homes integration
/home and /homes open the server-side Homes inventory GUI. /sethome <name> saves your position and /home <name> retains direct teleport. One starter slot plus four earned campaign slots gives total capacities 1/2/3/4/5 after starter/Bronze/Gold/Mythic/Ascendant. The GUI, creation checks and Perks screen are integrated. Existing homes and five-second teleport delay are preserved. No additional client mod is required by this patch.
